shooter.line_endings: line-ending normalization was attempted and REVERTED. Adding '* text=auto eol=lf' made .aikit/decisions.md -- whose committed blob contains 823 CR bytes -- permanently modified, because the clean filter normalizes it to LF while the stored blob is CRLF. Converting 338 tracked files to LF turned 328 of them into stat-only phantom modifications and one into a whole-file diff. The repository's committed content is genuinely mixed (decisions.md CRLF; sim.py, game.py, README.md and LICENSE LF), so pinning eol=lf requires a separate one-time renormalization commit that the user has not authorised; .gitattributes was removed and every touched file restored to its committed bytes, leaving 14 genuine modifications plus untracked files, which matches the pre-cycle state
shooter.guard: tests/test_repo_line_endings.py was strengthened twice. First version compared git status with git diff, which shares one stat cache and can agree while the tree is unchanged. Second version compared worktree bytes with the HEAD blob, which misses the case git actually cares about: a CRLF-only rewrite is normalised by the clean filter, so git reports it modified while hash-object still yields the committed blob. The final version compares git hash-object --path=<file> output with the HEAD blob. Probe: converting LICENSE to CRLF made status report 'M LICENSE' while the filtered hash equalled HEAD, and the guard failed naming LICENSE; restoring the committed bytes returned it to green. A reintroduced eol=lf .gitattributes also fails the other test, naming .aikit/decisions.md. Binary blobs are excluded by a NUL check (20 tracked blobs contain CR, 19 are PNGs).
shooter.subprocess_hygiene: every git call in tests/test_repo_line_endings.py carries an explicit timeout (the AIKit gate forbids untimed subprocess calls), tightened from 60s to GIT_TIMEOUT=15 after review; the per-file `git cat-file` loop was replaced by one `git cat-file --batch` read, verified byte-exact against single-blob reads for all 363 tracked files (e.g. decisions.md 145347 B, game.py 72596 B, LICENSE 8392 B). Suite time 2.00s -> 1.53s; the remaining second is the batch read itself, not process spawns
